name: Muhammed Hanan P P
tagline: Still learning, still building, still breaking things
bio: Third-year B.Tech CSE (AI) student at TKMCE, Kollam. Curious about newer technology and advancements in AI and ML. I learn best by building things and breaking them.

projects.title: Wildfire Suppressing Multi-Drone Agent
projects.desc: A custom wildfire simulation where four firefighting drones learn to cooperate using PPO reinforcement learning. Includes battery management, resource constraints and real-time PyGame visualization.

projects.title: Customer Segmentation
projects.desc: An interactive Streamlit dashboard that uses K-Means clustering to segment customers, visualize clusters with PCA, evaluate clustering quality and predict the segment of new customers.

projects.title: PowerGuard
projects.desc: A JavaFX desktop application that predicts electricity bills, tracks monthly budgets and benchmarks five machine learning models to select the best-performing model.

projects.title: Water Level Monitoring System
projects.desc: Developed an IoT-based water level monitoring system using Arduino UNO and ultrasonic sensors as part of Idea Lab (Semester 1).
